title: AD2 I2C Tool Decoder File
description: Validation schema for decoder files used by the AD2 I2C/SMBus Tool. A decoder is a list of rules; each rule names an I2C transaction type (per the standard I2C taxonomy), the register it targets (for indexed types), and how to turn the data bytes into a value + unit. Rules are keyed on (i2c_address, register, transaction_type).

version.description: Schema format version. Current engine uses version 4 (adds Registers-tab display groups + rule group/group_order/access).

i2c_address_hex.description: Optional hex form of the 7-bit address, e.g. '0x08'.

rules.description: List of decode rules, keyed on (address, register, transaction_type).

display_groups.description: Registers-tab layout (v4): ordered display groups. 'banner' groups render in the headline strip with dividers; 'pane' groups render as side-by-side parameter panes.

transaction_type.description: I2C bus transaction shape this rule matches (standard I2C taxonomy).

bitField.description: One named bit field within a format='bits' value. Covers an inclusive [high, low] range. Its 'mode' decides rendering: 'enum' (a name per value: 2^N names), 'scale' (value through 'function' + 'unit', with optional 'special' value labels), or 'raw' (integer as-is).

range.description: Inclusive [high, low] bit indices (high >= low). A single bit is [n, n].

names.description: mode='enum': display name for each value, indexed by value. Length should be 2^(high-low+1).

function.description: mode='scale': expression on the field value X, e.g. 'X*122.1'.

special.description: mode='scale': map specific raw values to a label that overrides the scaled output, e.g. {"0": "PWM disabled"}.

dataField.description: One sub-field of a structured payload (rule 'fields'), addressed by BYTE offset. Its bytes are assembled per byte_order/signed and rendered per format.

offset.description: Byte offset of the field within the payload buffer.

byte_order.description: Byte order used to assemble the field value.

signed.description: Interpret the assembled value as two's-complement.

format.description: Rendering: 'dec' (function result as a number+unit), 'hex' (0xNN zero-padded to the field width), 'raw' (integer as-is), 'ascii' (bytes as printable ASCII), or 'bits' (slice bit_fields out of the value).

function.description: Expression on the assembled value X, e.g. 'X*0.25'. Default 'X' (identity).

unit.description: Unit string appended to the rendered value, e.g. 'userA-s'.

bit_fields.description: For format='bits': named bit fields sliced from the assembled value (see #/definitions/bitField).

register.description: Register index byte(s). Required for indexed_read/indexed_write/split_transaction; must be omitted/null for simple_*, general_call, device_id_query. 0x00-0xFFFF for multi-byte indices.

register_width_bytes.description: Byte width of the register index on the wire (1 for 0x14, 2 for 0x0014).

subcommand.description: For transaction_type='subcommand': the 16-bit subcommand code (e.g. 0x0005 RESET_PASSQ) written to the subcommand register.

subcommand_reg.description: Register the subcommand code is written to (default 0x3E).

access.description: Datasheet access, e.g. 'R', 'W', 'R/W'. Drives the Registers tab's lock/pencil marker and (Phase 4 master) write controls.

description.description: Datasheet description of the register/subcommand, surfaced in the replay/editor.

unit.description: Unit appended to the value, e.g. 'mV'.

function.description: Value expression. For Decimal use float math (* / + -); for Hex use integer/logic/shift (<< >> & | ^ ~ + -). Operand X = assembled integer value. Optional for Bit Field rules (defaults to the raw value). E.g. 'X*0.1', 'X<<2', '(X>>4)&0x0F'.

byte_order.description: Byte order for multi-byte DATA values: 'be' (default) or 'le'.

signed.description: Interpret the assembled DATA value as two's-complement signed.

data_bytes.description: Expected number of DATA bytes (register index NOT counted). Read length for reads; value-byte count for writes. null/omitted = any length; data is trimmed to this count before evaluation when set.

format.description: Output format / function type for the decoded value: 'dec' (Decimal: float math with * and /, shown as a number + unit), 'hex' (Hex: integer/logic/shift math, shown as 0xNNNN), or 'bits' (Bit Field: the value's bits are sliced into named fields).

bit_fields.description: For format='bits': a list of named bit fields (see #/definitions/bitField).

fields.description: For subcommand block reads and other structured payloads: a list of byte-offset-addressed sub-fields. When present, the value is rendered field-by-field and the rule-level function/format/byte_order are ignored. Models the TRM subcommand tables (e.g. FW_VERSION = Device Number + FW Version + Build Number; PASSQ = PASSQLSB + PASSQMSB + PASSTIME).

name.description: Human label, e.g. 'Cell 1 Voltage'. Shown as 'Name = value unit'.

group.description: Registers-tab display group this rule appears in (v4). Scalar rules without a group don't appear in the top zone; format='bits' rules always join the Bit Registers matrix regardless.

group_order.description: Sort order within the display group (v4).

allOf.comment: Decimal and Hex formats require a function expression (except subcommands, which may be command-only).
Bit Field format requires a bit_fields list.
When no format is given it defaults to Decimal, so a function is required — except for command-only subcommands.
Subcommand rules require a subcommand code and must not carry a register.
Indexed read/write/split require a register index.
Simple read/write, general call, device ID query must NOT carry a register.
General Call targets the global broadcast address 0x00.
Device ID Query reads exactly 3 signature bytes.
